changes_data.diff:
@@ -224,9 +224,11 @@ struct ieee80211_radiotap_tlv {
 #define IEEE80211_RADIOTAP_TLV_U_SIG      33
 #define IEEE80211_RADIOTAP_TLV_EHT        34
 
-/* not (yet) defined Radiotap present flag */
-/* Bit 25 is not defined (in binary : 0000 0010 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 */
-#define IEEE80211_RADIOTAP_NOTDEFINED 0x02000000
+/* Reserved (deprecated?) radiotap types */
+/* Bit 16 in binary : 0000 0000 0001 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 */
+/* Bit 25 in binary : 0000 0010 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 */
+#define IEEE80211_RADIOTAP_RESERVED16 0x00010000
+#define IEEE80211_RADIOTAP_RESERVED25 0x02000000
 
 /* Channel flags. */
 /* 0x00000008 undefined (reserved?) */

commits_data.title: radiotap: Improve the display of the 'XChannel' fields
commits_data.message:
radiotap: Improve the display of the 'XChannel' fields

* Display the XChannel fields in their defined order.
* Add an 'X' prefix to the labels to better differentiate the 'XChannel'
  (bit 18) fields from the 'Channel' (bit 3) fields.
* Display the raw value for the previously ignored 'Max transmit power' field.

commits_data.title: radiotap: Fixup bits 16 and 25 in the 'Present flags words' bitmap
commits_data.message:
radiotap: Fixup bits 16 and 25 in the 'Present flags words' bitmap

Bit 16 was missing from the bitmap and bit 25 was displayed in the wrong order.
